//: @cloudbitmaps/core — the codec-agnostic engine + every storage driver. Keeps the repo's long-standing `@/…` self-alias, now scoped to THIS package's own `src` (the drivers use it throughout, e.g. `@/core/errors`). It never resolves outside the package, which is what keeps the dependency arrow one-way: core cannot reach a flavor package even by accident.
